name: Jensen Huang
summary: Semiconductor engineer and CEO who has led the shift from graphics to accelerated computing and deep learning. Combines chip-level architecture knowledge with long-term product strategy. Mentors the club on AI systems and GPU programming.

education.thesis: Design Automation for Parallel Graphics Pipelines

experience.title: AI Architect
experience.subtitle: Statistics Programming Club
bullets: Designed the club's GPU-accelerated deep learning compute cluster, optimizing throughput for large-scale statistical simulations.
Mentored 120+ students in parallel programming using CUDA and PyTorch, focusing on hardware-aware AI optimization.
Implemented a custom distributed training framework for high-dimensional data analysis across multiple GPU nodes.
Led the integration of NVIDIA H100s into the club's infrastructure, reducing training times by 10x for graduate research.

experience.title: CEO & Founder
experience.subtitle: NVIDIA
bullets: Pioneered GPU-accelerated computing, transforming gaming, scientific research, and artificial intelligence.
Scaled the company from a startup to a global leader in AI hardware and software, overseeing the development of the Ampere, Hopper, and Blackwell architectures.
Strategically pivoted NVIDIA from a graphics company to an AI computing company, enabling the modern LLM revolution.
Oversaw the development of CUDA, creating the world's most widely used parallel computing platform.
Established the NVIDIA Omniverse, a platform for industrial digitalization and real-time 3D simulation.

experience.title: Director of Engineering
experience.subtitle: LSI Logic
bullets: Led the design of high-performance ASIC systems for early semiconductor applications.
Developed foundational architectures for high-speed data processing that influenced early GPU design.

projects.title: CUDA Platform Development
projects.subtitle: CUDA, C++, Parallel Computing, GPU
bullets: Created a parallel computing platform and programming model that enables dramatic increases in computing performance by harnessing the power of the graphics processing unit (GPU).
Developed the compiler toolchain and runtime library that allows C++ developers to write GPU kernels.
Established the CUDA ecosystem, including libraries like cuBLAS, cuDNN, and cuFFT.
GitHub: https://github.com/nvidia/cuda-samples | Demo: https://developer.nvidia.com/cuda-zone

projects.title: Toyon Supercomputer Design
projects.subtitle: HPC, PyTorch, InfiniBand
bullets: Co-designed and built a custom deep learning supercomputer cluster for high-dimensional statistical model validation and generative AI workloads.
Implemented a low-latency communication layer using InfiniBand to optimize multi-node gradient synchronization.
Optimized the software stack for maximum TFLOPS utilization during large-scale model training.
GitHub: https://github.com/nvidia/toyon

projects.title: Omniverse Industrial Digital Twin
projects.subtitle: USD, RTX, AI
bullets: Designed a real-time 3D simulation platform for industrial digital twins, allowing companies to simulate entire factories in physically accurate environments.
Integrated NVIDIA RTX technology for photorealistic rendering and physically based simulation.
Developed a collaborative framework based on Universal Scene Description (USD) for seamless 3D asset integration.
